title: moeb-tool-origin: Read called on README.md after read_file returned persisted-output
description: During run 004c6afb-9d83-474f-bc34-1046fffa1cfd, read_file on .moeb/README.md returned a persisted-output notice (66.3 KB exceeded context limit), and the agent fell back to the native Read tool to obtain the full file content. The temp file could have been accessed via read_file with absolute:true (implemented in moeb.read-file-absolute-path-support). No MissingMoebTool signal was buffered for the fallback.
proposed_resolution: When read_file returns persisted-output, access the temp path via read_file with absolute:true instead of falling back to the native Read tool. Buffer a MissingMoebTool signal if the workaround is unavoidable.
